label: V6.3.41 · fix FSAGS54/94 direct interaction
notes: Fix direct tap/edit interaction on FSAGS54 and FSAGS94. Editing now follows LOADCONTROL_CHECKLIST/CLC_CHECKLIST permission and active flight/form context, without requiring rosterAssignmentId or QUICK_TIME. Native SVG hit targets are preserved and the page-level handler is fallback-only. V6.3.40 PDF permission fix is retained.
message: V6.3.41: sửa tương tác trực tiếp FSAGS54/FSAGS94; giữ nguyên quyền xuất PDF V6.3.40.
